## Houston v0.6.13

- Houston on mobile now has Agents, Tasks, and Settings tabs, plus a dedicated home for your agents.
- Mobile task boards now let you swipe between stages and open or create tasks in a focused full-screen chat.
- Files created by agents now open reliably from chat links across cloud and desktop.
- Apps that require no account connection now appear ready to use instead of showing connection errors.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
